links.outcome: LLM accuracy on 2025 GOLD COPD guideline questions, binary and open-ended
links.effect: Binary accuracy ranged from 89.5% (Gemini 3) to 97.1% (Kimi K1.5); binary error rates 2.9% to 10.5%; open-ended weighted-score deficits 3.5% to 8.2%.
links.quote: Residual performance gaps persisted across both domains, with binary error rates ranging from 2.9% (Kimi K1.5) to 10.5% (Gemini 3), and open-ended weighted-score deficits ranging from 3.5% (Gemini 3) to 8.2% (DeepSeek-V3.2).

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across repeated daily runs over 7 days
links.effect: All platforms showed statistical stability across the seven-day study period (p > 0.05 for all models).
links.quote: All platforms exhibited statistical stability across the seven-day study period (p > 0.05 for all models).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance and adherence of multiple LLMs to the 2025 GOLD COPD guidelines using a standardized question set across multiple days, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
